node.title: Re: Perl images for GitLab CI
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
"[https://registry.hub.docker.com/_/perl/|Perl - Official Image|Docker Hub]"

On that page, if you go to the tab "Tags", you'll see Perl builds all the way down to 5.8. This is also confirmed if you go to the [https://github.com/Perl/docker-perl/tree/master/eol|GitHub repo] from which these "official" images are built. I haven’t tried the GitLab CI so unfortunately I can't say anything about that.
